title: Manager, Talent & Workforce Analytics, Global Strategic Workforce Planning (m/f/d)
description: Bei Daiichi Sankyo stehen wir vereint hinter einem einzigen Ziel: Das Leben auf der ganzen Welt durch innovative Medikamente zu verbessern. Mit aktiver Innovation seit 1899, Präsenz in mehr als 30 Ländern und über 19.000 Mitarbeitern entwickeln wir bahnbrechende Therapien in der Onkologie, für Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, seltene Krankheiten und Immunerkrankungen. Im Einklang mit unserer Vision 2030, "ein innovatives globales Gesundheitsunternehmen zu sein, das zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung der Gesellschaft beiträgt", gestalten wir eine gesündere, hoffnungsvollere Zukunft für Patienten, ihre Familien und die Gesellschaft. About the Role As Daiichi Sankyo continues its growth journey, our ability to anticipate future talent needs is a key business imperative. We are building a world-class Global Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) & Insights capability. As the technical engine of this capability, you will build, automate and own the workforce analytics solutions that power our workforce strategy. You will partner closely with HR, Finance, Corporate Business Planning and business stakeholders to deliver data-driven insights and support strategic workforce decision-making. The position can be filled at one of our European affiliates (with a preference for placement in Germany), the US or Japan. Key Responsibilities Workforce Planning, Analytics & Insights Build, maintain and enhance workforce analytics models supporting strategic workforce planning and delivery model design. Run supply/demand forecasting, scenario modelling and workforce segmentation analyses to identify talent risks, gaps and trends. Analyse workforce trends, turnover and talent pipeline data to surface risks and opportunities. Deliver predictive and prescriptive analytics that inform workforce decisions and talent deployment. Translate business requirements into robust data models and reliable outputs. Provide analytical support to other Talent & Performance Development CoE teams as required. Data Governance & Reporting Lead the development, maintenance and automation of core analytics products, including the Global SWP Dashboard, scenario-modelling tools and recurring reports. Aggregate, integrate and validate workforce data from HR, business and finance systems. Lead data collection and validation across global stakeholders and data owners. Partner with HRIS teams to enhance data structures and reporting capabilities. Act as the subject matter expert for complex data, technology, privacy and security topics. Maintain clear documentation of code, data structures and processes. Strategic Partnership Collaborate with HR, Finance, Corporate Business Planning and business stakeholders to deliver SWP priorities. Support planning discussions through analytical insights and interpretation. Contribute to workforce planning standards and enterprise frameworks. Present complex findings through clear visualisations and compelling data narratives. Ensure workforce planning data and tools remain accurate, reliable and business-focused. Continuous Improvement Stay current on workforce analytics, AI, emerging technologies and industry trends. Identify and lead automation and process improvement opportunities. Evaluate new data sources to strengthen workforce insights. Contribute to advancing analytical capability across HR. Qualifications Bachelor's degree required; Master's preferred in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, or a related field 5+ years of experience in a data-intensive role such as Data Analyst, BI Developer, Data Engineer or People Analytics Advanced expertise in Alteryx, Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Python/Pandas, Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric Demonstrated experience in data collection, validation and stakeholder management Experience delivering projects within global and multicultural environments Workforce analytics, predictive modelling and HR data experience preferred Pharma, biotech or life sciences experience is an advantage Business-fluent English required; German or Japanese is a plus Warum Sie bei uns richtig sind Bei Daiichi Sankyo zu arbeiten, ist mehr als nur ein Job – es ist Ihre Chance, das Leben von Patient*innen zu verbessern. Dieses ehrgeizige Ziel können wir nur gemeinsam erreichen. Deshalb pflegen wir eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts und des kontinuierlichen Lernens, die von Vielfalt und Inklusion geprägt ist. Hier haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln, mutig zu denken und Ihre Ideen einzubringen. Sie arbeiten proaktiv und möchten sich für die Bedürfnisse von Patient*innen einsetzen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt!
